summary.plain: A high, remote research station at the very top of the Greenland ice sheet, more than three kilometres above sea level, where the RNO-G neutrino detector is being built into the ice.
summary.technical: Summit Station: year-round research station at the summit of the Greenland ice sheet, 72°N 38°W, elevation 3200 m, operated by Battelle Arctic Research Operations for the NSF Arctic Research Program; hosts the Radio Neutrino Observatory Greenland (RNO-G).
